key_findings: Novel N-sulfonylurea compound 4b, an MCC950 analogue, inhibits IL-1β release, caspase-1 activation and ASC oligomerization in vitro.
Compound 4b reduced inflammation and mechanical hyperalgesia in a mouse gout model.
